name: Ollama
description: Local large language model server with an OpenAI-compatible API.
about: Runs open-weight language models on your own hardware and serves them over an HTTP API on port 11434, with OpenAI-compatible routes under /v1. The container starts with no models. Pull one with ollama pull from the container console, or from any client pointed at the API.

variables.label: Data folder
variables.description: Stores downloaded models and Ollama keys.

variables.label: API port
variables.description: Unauthenticated API port, anyone who can reach it can run or download models.

variables.label: GPU device
variables.description: GPU device path, such as /dev/dri, for Vulkan on supported x86 GPUs. Blank uses the CPU. NVIDIA requires container runtime settings this template cannot configure.

variables.label: Keep model loaded for
variables.description: How long a model stays in memory after its last request, 5 minutes when blank. A duration such as 30m, or seconds. Use -1 to keep it loaded, or 0 to drop it as soon as a response finishes.

variables.label: Context length
variables.description: Tokens of context a model gets unless the request asks for something else. Blank lets Ollama pick from the VRAM it finds. Memory use grows with this number.

variables.label: Parallel requests
variables.description: Concurrent requests per model, 1 when blank, each requiring its own context memory.

variables.label: Models loaded at once
variables.description: How many models stay in memory together, as long as they fit. Blank means 3 per GPU, or 3 on the CPU. Requests for a model that will not fit wait until an idle one is unloaded.

variables.label: Flash attention
variables.description: Reduces memory use for long contexts, leave blank for the backend default.

variables.label: K/V cache quantization
variables.description: Shrinks the context cache, and only takes effect with flash attention on. Blank is f16. q8_0 uses about half the memory, q4_0 about a quarter, with more quality lost the smaller it gets.

variables.label: Allowed browser origins
variables.description: Comma separated origins a browser may call the API from. localhost, 127.0.0.1, and 0.0.0.0 are always allowed. Extensions need their own scheme, such as chrome-extension://*.

variables.label: Local models only
variables.description: Turns off Ollama's cloud models and its web search, leaving the models on this host.

variables.label: Debug logging
variables.description: Writes debug messages, including GPU detection, to the container log.
